sections.title: Plant form and flowers
sections.text: A small Mexican Turbinicarpus cactus with a globose to short cylindrical, tuberculate stem and pale flowers. The plate’s rounded, strongly ribbed body and white-to-pink flower fit this species; exact adult dimensions vary among accounts, so no fixed size is given.

sections.title: Habitat and protection
sections.text: Native to San Luis Potosí, Mexico, where it grows in dry, rocky sites. It is a cactus with spines; no edible use is documented. Wild collection and trade in cacti are regulated under CITES.
